title: The Pentagon Graph Operator
summary: For a graph $G$, let $\mathscr{C}_5(G)$ denote the graph whose vertices are the induced $5$-cycles of $G$, where two vertices are adjacent whenever the corresponding cycles share an edge. We investigate the iterative behavior of the pentagon graph operator $\mathscr{C}_5(G)$ , positioning it as the natural continuation of the quadrangle graph operator and the broader induced-cycle graph operator program.
